Sam Support: flagging Veridian Labs (VL-303) onboarding stall. Activation emails bouncing after SAML upload. Ticket: https://redwood.zd/ticket/71234
Lin CS: quick questions - renewal window and who's the CSM?
Sam Support: renewal in ~39 days. CSM is Asha. IdP admin engaged.
Asha CS Lead: on it. paste the error & metadata URL pls
Sam Support: logs:
```
SAML Error: AudienceRestrictionFailed - assertion audience does not match SP entityID
SP metadata: https://sso.veridianlabs.com/metadata.xml
```
Sam Support: reprovisioned once, still failing. IdP team says they pushed updated metadata; ETA for full sync ~2h.
Lin CS: immediate plan: 1) warm handoff to CS in 20m, 2) send customer-friendly status now, 3) draft concise fallback for IdP admin, 4) schedule enablement tomorrow AM PST. Asha, will you own the handoff?
Asha CS Lead: I will. Owners: Asha -> handoff + invite (include IdP admin), Lin -> customer comm templates, Rory -> fallback doc, Clara -> AE prep for renewal outreach. Success metric = pilot seats live by EOD tomorrow.
Rory Solutions: drafting minimal fallback (will post to #eng-platform):
- confirm SP entityID and ACS in account settings
- temp relax AudienceRestriction in staging
- run `redwood saml sync --tenant VL-303 --force --dry-run`
- verify with `curl -I https://app.veridianlabs.com/_health`
Lin CS: comms: two templates - one short ops note for IdP admins, one exec-friendly update. Sam please send the exec-friendly note now: "We're investigating an SSO provisioning mismatch and preparing a temporary workaround; we'll schedule a call for tomorrow morning PST." :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Sam Support: sent at 4167777833. Customer replied: "Thanks, we'll include our IdP admin and are available tomorrow AM." :thumbsup:
Asha CS Lead: setting account health = "at-risk - onboarding" and creating a 7-day renewal watch cadence; will escalate to AE if no progress in 24h. Also capturing feedback: onboarding quickstart missing IdP examples and audience/ACS troubleshooting steps.
TaskBot: created task VL-303-warm-handoff assigned to Asha, due 4167778460.
Lin CS: I'll post a short follow-up summary in this thread after the enablement call. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
